description: Renovate preset for repos on the Kubermatic frontend stack.
Two jobs. Group the @kubermatic/* packages so a kit release lands as one PR
rather than three that each half-update a product. And leave the singletons
alone: their versions come from versions.json via `kubermatic-config check`,
so a Renovate PR bumping react past the manifest would be reverted by CI on
the next run. Bump the manifest instead.

packageRules.description: One PR for the whole kit.
Owned by ui-kit / ui-patterns. A product should not have these at all; if one does, `kubermatic-config check` already fails on it, and a Renovate PR would only keep the copy alive.
Singletons are pinned by the manifest, not by Renovate.
